verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents exporting errors as issues to GitHub, GitLab, Jira Cloud and Jira Server, with full markdown or Jira wiki content, which covers the 'link an error to a tracker' part of the story. Nothing shows status flowing back, so closing a ticket resolving the error, or a regression reopening the ticket, is unevidenced. Missing for 10: two-way status sync (ticket close resolves error, regression reopens ticket), Linear integration, independent corroboration.
